semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in inspection and measurement equipment critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Component Technology Pte., Ltd. is a leading supplier of advanced inspection and measurement solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on post die and wire bond automated optical inspection (AOI). The company collaborates closely with automotive electronics and high-end semiconductor manufacturers to deliver innovative technology that enhances process control and quality assurance.
capabilities: Automated X-ray inspection for wire bond and die voids detection
Wafer inspection and leadframe measurement solutions
Die and wire bond inspection systems
Data analysis software for process control

regional_presence.Singapore: Incorporated in Singapore, the company has established strong relationships with global semiconductor manufacturers and OSATs.
